title: Requirements and trust-boundary matrix for the research prototype
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Separate each actor, data and action boundary from the current local mechanism, outstanding authorised work, explicit stop condition and available evidence state.

status.interpretation: In-place status applies only to named repository mechanisms and current local tests. It does not establish source truth, legal authority, live company-research completion, human benefit, security effectiveness or production readiness.

placement.integration: Input immediately after Section 4.1 prose and before Section 4.2.

boundary_traceability.status: Next.js is the loopback-published dashboard; its server-side proxy reaches private FastAPI. Host/client/CSRF/configured-reviewer mechanisms are local controls, not production authentication.
Companies House number-only intake and named decision are implemented offline; live registry truth remains held.
Classification/provider controls are implemented; restricted-data authority and participant ethics evidence are unavailable.
Code and local/fake checks exist; no live public-company execution or quality result is claimed.
Approval/export mechanisms are locally tested; authorised human observation and reviewer-utility results are unavailable.
Remote, multi-user and production operation require separate design, authority and evidence.

limitations: The exhibit contains no empirical value, participant observation, coverage result, cost, timing, source-quality score or production claim.

Local tests establish only exercised contracts; they do not establish ethics approval, data authority, source lawfulness, live availability, model quality, security effectiveness or external validity.
Offline Companies House syntax and intake do not prove current legal identity or registry truth.
store=False is not represented as Zero Data Retention and does not replace processing authority or minimisation.
A configured local reviewer is an accountable prototype actor, not a production authenticated principal or evidence of an authorised participant study.
self_hash_policy: The provenance file's own SHA-256 is reported externally because embedding it would create a self-referential hash.
